## GitHub Repository

All the code, data and Quarto source files for this portfolio are on GitHub: <https://github.com/IsabellaLethbridge/Time_Series>.

To reproduce any page, clone the repository, open `Time_Series.Rproj` in RStudio and render the page (or run `quarto render` for the whole site). The data files are in `_data/` and `projects/_data/`.

## R Code and Scripts

The code for each project is embedded in its detailed analysis (see [Computational Notebooks and Reports](#computational-notebooks-and-reports)). The standalone scripts below are shared between pages or run outside the portfolio. Click a script name to show the code.

### HMM toolkit

`scripts/hmm-toolkit.R`: my hidden Markov model functions (scaled forward and backward algorithms, local decoding, the Viterbi algorithm, the stationary distribution, the working-parameter transformation and matrix powers for forecasting). Used by [Project 4](../projects/project-04-analysis.qmd) and the [Hidden Markov Models](../section-2/section-2.qmd#hidden-markov-models) part of Section 2.

```{r}

#| eval: false

#| code-summary: "hmm-toolkit.R"
```

### JSE regime explorer (Shiny app)

`scripts/shiny-app/`: the interactive companion to Project 4. It is online at <https://isabellalethbridge.shinyapps.io/shiny-app/>. To run it locally, run `precompute.R` first, then `shiny::runApp("scripts/shiny-app")` from the portfolio root.

## Data Access

Full download instructions are in the Data section of each detailed analysis. None of the datasets contain personal information.

| Data | Used in | File | Source |
|------------------|------------------|------------------|------------------|
| Hourly RSA contracted demand (MW), 2019 to 2024 | [Project 1](../projects/project-01-analysis.qmd#data) | `ESK6816.csv` | Provided by the course lecturer; originally from the Eskom Data Portal, <https://www.eskom.co.za/dataportal/> |
| Theewaterskloof Dam levels from 2000 | [Project 2](../projects/project-02-analysis.qmd#data) | `Dam_Levels_from_2000.csv` | City of Cape Town Open Data Portal, <https://odp-cctegis.opendata.arcgis.com/> |
| Daily sea surface temperature, seven TAO buoys on 95°W | [Project 2](../projects/project-02-analysis.qmd#data) | `sst*95w_dy.ascii` | NOAA PMEL TAO Data Delivery, <https://www.pmel.noaa.gov/tao/drupal/disdel/> |
| Daily FTSE/JSE All Share Index, 1994 to 2017 | [Project 3](../projects/project-03-analysis.qmd#data), [Project 4](../projects/project-04-analysis.qmd#data) | `PT-DATA-ALBI-JIBAR-JSEIND-Daily-1994-2017.xlsx` | Gebbie (2020), University of Cape Town, <https://doi.org/10.25375/uct.11302325.v1> |
| Seal counts | [Section 1](../section-1/section-1.qmd) | `seals.csv` | Course data |

: {tbl-colwidths="[28,17,22,33]"}

Other examples in Sections 1 and 2 use datasets built into R and its packages (for example `AirPassengers`).
